statements: The shortest war in history was between Britain and Zanzibar on August 27, 1896, and lasted only 38 minutes. Zanzibar surrendered after just 12 minutes of fighting, and the remaining 26 minutes were spent on ceasefire negotiations.
The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system, located in the Coral Sea, off the coast of Queensland, Australia, and spans more than 2,300 kilometers.
The city of Petra, in modern-day Jordan, was the capital of the ancient Roman province of Arabia Petraea during the reign of Emperor Augustus.
